meta.title: Solutions — DESIREFIT EV Charging Infrastructure
meta.description: DESIREFIT delivers end-to-end EV charging solutions — from site assessment and hardware supply to installation, software integration, and ongoing support.

hero.headline: End-to-End EV Charging Infrastructure
hero.subheading: From initial site assessment through to commissioning and long-term support, DESIREFIT delivers complete charging infrastructure — engineered for commercial scale.

solutions.title: Site Assessment & Design
solutions.description: Every DESIREFIT project begins with a thorough site assessment. Our engineers evaluate electrical capacity, load requirements, cable routing, and future scalability to design an infrastructure that works today and grows with your business.

deliverables.text: Charger placement and cable routing design
Grid connection and DNO application support

solutions.title: Hardware Supply & Installation
solutions.description: We supply and install our full range of commercial EV chargers — from 7.4 kW AC units to 350 kW DC fast chargers. Every installation is completed by certified engineers to IEC 61851 and local wiring standards.

deliverables.text: Full range of AC and DC charging hardware
Civil works, groundworks, and cable management

solutions.title: Software & Network Integration
solutions.description: All DESIREFIT hardware connects to our Smart Management Platform via OCPP 2.0. We handle full network configuration, backend integration, and user access setup — so your charging network is live and managed from day one.

deliverables.text: RFID, payment, and access control setup
Integration with fleet TMS, ERP, or billing systems

solutions.title: Ongoing Support & Maintenance
solutions.description: Our support doesn't end at handover. DESIREFIT provides 24/7 remote monitoring, proactive fault detection, and on-site maintenance to keep your charging network running at peak performance.

deliverables.text: OTA firmware updates and remote diagnostics
99.9% uptime SLA with response time guarantees

steps.title: Initial Inquiry
steps.description: Contact our team with your site details and requirements. We'll respond within one business day.

steps.title: Site Assessment
steps.description: Our engineers visit your site to assess electrical capacity, layout, and infrastructure needs.

steps.title: Proposal & Design
steps.description: We deliver a detailed proposal with hardware recommendations, installation scope, and pricing.

steps.title: Installation
steps.description: Certified engineers complete the full installation, civil works, and network configuration.

steps.title: Go Live & Support
steps.description: Your network goes live with full monitoring, reporting, and 24/7 support from day one.

cta.headline: Ready to Get Started?
cta.subheading: Contact our team for a free site assessment and infrastructure proposal tailored to your requirements.
